github.description: GitHub MCP — PRs, issues, code search, workflows, labels, releases. Copilot-managed auth.

fetch.description: HTTP client for testing dashboard data sources (Open-Meteo, Hebcal, Yahoo, CoinGecko). GET/POST with headers.

filesystem.description: Workspace-scoped file ops — coverage reports, test outputs, configs, build artifacts. Heavy directories excluded.

gitkraken.description: Git blame, log, diff, branch ops, PR workflow. Cross-repo MyScripts/ monorepo work.

playwright.description: Browser automation, visual debugging, screenshot capture, and E2E interaction directly in chat.
